infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed to attach photos and videos when creating Events and Capsules in Chronopedia.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is needed to record audio notes when creating Events and Capsules in Chronopedia.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is needed to attach images and videos from your gallery when creating Events and Capsules.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Permission is needed to save media from Events and Capsules to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access is needed to place Events at your current position on the world map in Chronopedia.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Location access is needed to place Events at your current position on the world map in Chronopedia.
